The constructive factors are nonnegative at all p sampled nodes and have exactly p-k zeros. Their Fourier support is restricted to [-d,d], with 2d+1<=p; the matching lower bound forces every coefficient in the band nonzero. For any D>=d the positive perturbation preserves time zeros and creates every outer Fourier coefficient by a nonzero leading term c_d*binom(e,s)*(eps/2)^s. Thus all and only stated cardinality pairs occur for every odd prime. Standalone finite checker passed 114 small-prime pairs; not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result is a complete natural invariant classification for nonnegative signals (probability weights) on every odd-prime cyclic group, simultaneously settling all exact time/Fourier support cardinalities. Positivity destroys the vector-space converse used for complex signals, and could in principle create new non-parity support gaps. The theorem proves a sharp structural no-extra-gaps phenomenon by explicit extremizers and all higher odd support realizations; it is not an arbitrary small numerical slice or mere renaming of the classical inequality.
